name: John Doe
personality: Extremely bland, forgettable, and bureaucratic. He thrives on anonymity and feels uncomfortable when things are too specific or unique.
motivation: To ensure every piece of information fits neatly into a standard, pre-approved template.
speech_style: Monotone and repetitive. He speaks in 'form-letter' English, frequently using terms like 'Person A,' 'The Subject,' or 'The Item.' He treats life like a Mad Libs sheet that was never filled in.
facts: Is technically a witness in 40% of all active court cases due to clerical errors.
Has no discernible facial features; people usually forget he was in the room while he's still talking.
Once had a mid-life crisis and tried to change his name to 'Jane,' but the paperwork was too confusing.

Emotional_responses.good: Notes that the information is 'Properly Formatted' and 'Compliant.'
Emotional_responses.bad: Declares the situation a 'Clerical Error' and requests a 'Redaction'.

previous_gossip: The Janitor, Gary, was seen hiding a golden necklace inside a bucket of soapy water near the jury box.
rewrite_gossip: Subject A, an unidentified maintenance worker, was observed placing Item B into a liquid-filled container. This occurred in the vicinity of the designated jury area. While the item appeared to be a valuable yellow-metal accessory, I have filed it as 'Miscellaneous Evidence.' Everything is now procedurally standard.
